address: 48 Main Street, Kinsale, P17 XY07, Ireland
bio: This well-loved restaurant is an efficiently run spot located on Kinsale's quaint main street. Inside, it has a simple yet smart rustic style, with guests spread across two dining rooms. The menu sticks to unfussy, classically based dishes that deliver well-executed, wholly satisfying versions of tried-and-tested combinations. As you're not far from the coast here, seafood plays a large role, including prime fish and shellfish from local suppliers....
